0022600127.text: The Golden State Warriors (0-3, 15th in the West) are looking for their first win as they visit the Denver Nuggets (1-1, 7th in the West), who are coming off a win. Golden State is ruled out without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Brandon Williams (back soreness), Charles Bassey (knee), and Gui Santos (knee tendinitis) are day-to-day with game-time decisions, while Denver is without Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring) and has Alpha Diallo (wrist) and Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain) listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, with the most recent meeting on 2026-03-29 in Denver, when the Warriors lost 116-93.
